posts.author: 46roneko
posts.body:
I'm a 24yo computer scientist from Brazil, currently on my PhD. I live in Japan with no plans on going back!
I'm a C and embedded systems developer, and do game dev on my spare time. I also really like C++ and Lua. I'm currently learning x86 ASM, and I'm also slowly learning hacking and reverse engineering.
Just recently started getting back on RPG Maker, using MV and probably will try to make a short game. I have published games before (free games) with Godot 3 and 4!
I'm also a big otaku, I love learning new languages (either coding or "real" languages), and my favourite anime include Mahou Shoujo Madoka Magica, Samurai Champloo, Gundam Iron-Blooded Orphans, and Sword Art Online (yes I do like it leave me alone pls). My favourite games and franchises include Ragnarok Online, the Atelier series, Sonic series, Souls series, and Splatoon series. I also love MMORPGs and JRPGs in general.
I hope to make some friends here and post my future plugins!
Please treat me well ( •̀ ω •́ )y

Howdy! Welcome to the forums. Crikey, that's a lot of skill you possess! If you have a website where your other games're listed, let us know! I think it'd be awesome to see what you've made!
Nothing wrong with enjoying something a lot; I've probably ingested far more anime than any sane human should, but it's a good laugh regardless. You possess excellent taste!
Take care, and hope you have fun here!
